limitations: Parameters are predeclared hypotheses, not fitted travel preferences.
Tract centroids represent distributed populations; access to individual residents is not observed.
Resident and job opportunity units are not unique people and are never labeled visits.
Household income is a resident affordability proxy, not individual spending or worker income.
Transit schedules, cycling and driving routes are not modeled by the walking component.
The local OSM graph has no independently verified historical availability manifest.
